correctness.rationale: PASS: Every named triple of equivalence relations on n labels is a triple of set partitions, uniquely representable by restricted-growth strings. Orbit-transversal selection for E under S_n, F under stab(E), G under stab(E,F) is complete and without duplication. A single globally synchronized vertex color refinement retaining the full eight joint binary atomic masks and equality is equivalent to C² counting-logic equivalence for finite binary signatures. Independent rebuilt orbit/refinement enumeration at n=6 (not just reading output) produced exactly 21,205 isomorphism types, 21,197 stable C² classes, 8 doubletons and no larger classes. Brute count of the 20 unordered triples in each of the 16 exceptional structures produced 0 vs 2 common transversals in every paired class; permuting the three relation names produced doubleton orbits of sizes 1,1,3,3. The source scripts separately offer Burnside fixed-partition orbit counts, exhaustive isomorphism checks and pairwise WL tests. A single three-variable existential common-transversal sentence therefore separates each ambiguity and thus all types for n<=6 (all smaller types already C²-distinct). No higher-size inference is made.
